name: Earthing-switch-open breaker interlock
summary: Blocks closing toward a circuit when the associated earthing switch is not proved open.
description: Blocks closing toward a circuit when the associated earthing switch is not proved open. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Earthing-switch position” at the input and “Breaker closing inhibit” at the output. All relevant earthing points must be considered.
